messages:
Anya: Quick midday async check-in — renewal/adoption blockers for Tidewave Corp.
What I did: ran backfill for missing embeddings, escalated webhook retry loop to eng.
Blockers: 1) webhook retries still flapping after patch (customers seeing duplicate events), 2) embeddings latency spike ~2-3s higher in eu-west, 3) renewal call 15:00 PT needs an ETA on fixes.
Today: need eng review of PR #912 (rate-limit routing tweak), and a short metric to join retries -> region (Grafana panel).

Matt: Looking now — can you paste logs for the retry loop? I can pick up PR review at lunch.

Anya: pasted logs in thread — see blob below. It's mostly 429s from their webhook endpoint but our retry backoff isn't jittered.
logs:
```
2026-03-16T11:02:14Z tidewave-webhook 429 -> queued retry
2026-03-16T11:02:15Z retry attempt 3 backoff 2s
2026-03-16T11:02:18Z retry attempt 4 backoff 4s
... (repeats)
```

Devon: I can add jitter and tighten the per-customer token bucket. If Matt can review PR by 12:45 PT I can open a canary patch for the dedicated pool at 13:30.

Matt: Will review now. Minor nit in PR but nothing blocking. Setting review -> approved in 20m.

Jess: Heads up — renewal call attendees list updated. @Anya can you surface the ETA slide? Also CS needs a fallback talking point if patch misses window. :spiral_note_pad: 

Anya: ETA slide ready, I'll paste it into the call notes. Fallback talking point: offer a 48h dedicated capacity migration window while we stabilize, price-protected for that period. I'll add to the deck.

OncallBot: Deploy window available 13:30-13:45 PT in eu-west. Canaries set to 5% traffic. Link: https://deploys.internal/runs/9854 :rocket: 

Devon: Queued the jitter patch to canary and watching metrics. If retries reduce >90% we schedule hotfix rollout.

Anya: thank you all — i'll join the renewals call with the ETA and fallback. I'll update this thread with canary results.

Matt: Confirmed review done, merged. CI green.

OncallBot: Canary passed health checks at +12m. Error-rate(5m) down 93% for tidewave-* keys.

Anya: Perfect — noted. Adding this to the renewal notes and tagging CS owner. cc: @Jess :white_check_mark:
